meta.title: Dimming
meta.description: The clouds have moved across the face of the rainbows and the stars, and I cannot see the light of which you speak.

units.rawText: In the Cyclopes Sector, near the training field.
units.displayText: In the Cyclopes Sector, near the training field.

spans.text: In the Cyclopes Sector, near the training field.

units.rawText: Um... Er... 4You is holding a concert in the Cyclopes Sector, if you're interested...
units.displayText: Um... Er... 4You is holding a concert in the Cyclopes Sector, if you're interested...

spans.text: Um... Er... 4You is holding a concert in the Cyclopes Sector, if you're interested...

units.rawText: Our first show will take place in six days' time, if you'd like to know more, you can follow...
units.displayText: Our first show will take place in six days' time, if you'd like to know more, you can follow...

spans.text: Our first show will take place in six days' time, if you'd like to know more, you can follow...

units.rawText: The surrounding agents ignore the members of 4You and walk past them like they weren't there, filling the trio with a sense of defeat.
units.displayText: The surrounding agents ignore the members of 4You and walk past them like they weren't there, filling the trio with a sense of defeat.

spans.text: The surrounding agents ignore the members of 4You and walk past them like they weren't there, filling the trio with a sense of defeat.

units.rawText: Handing out flyers doesn't seem to be very effective... The last time I felt this bummed out was during the Wishing Fist tournament...
units.displayText: Handing out flyers doesn't seem to be very effective... The last time I felt this bummed out was during the Wishing Fist tournament...

spans.text: Handing out flyers doesn't seem to be very effective... The last time I felt this bummed out was during the Wishing Fist tournament...

units.rawText: They're completely uninterested in what we have to say...
units.displayText: They're completely uninterested in what we have to say...

spans.text: They're completely uninterested in what we have to say...

units.rawText: If we could get Anna to hack into the administrator's terminal and send a "watch the 4You concert at this time" command to all the agents in the sector...
units.displayText: If we could get Anna to hack into the administrator's terminal and send a "watch the 4You concert at this time" command to all the agents in the sector...

spans.text: If we could get Anna to hack into the administrator's terminal and send a "watch the 4You concert at this time" command to all the agents in the sector...

units.rawText: There'd be no point in holding a concert if we had to force them to watch it.
units.displayText: There'd be no point in holding a concert if we had to force them to watch it.

spans.text: There'd be no point in holding a concert if we had to force them to watch it.

units.rawText: Hm? Then let's ask Nameless to lend us the big screen at the training field.
units.displayText: Hm? Then let's ask Nameless to lend us the big screen at the training field.

spans.text: Hm? Then let's ask Nameless to lend us the big screen at the training field.

units.rawText: What do you have in mind?
units.displayText: What do you have in mind?

spans.text: What do you have in mind?

units.rawText: We're going to loop recordings of our previous shows on the big screen, of course.
units.displayText: We're going to loop recordings of our previous shows on the big screen, of course.

spans.text: We're going to loop recordings of our previous shows on the big screen, of course.

units.rawText: The training field is the place with the biggest concentration of agents. Surely some of them would slack off there and watch the big screen in between training sessions, right?
units.displayText: The training field is the place with the biggest concentration of agents. Surely some of them would slack off there and watch the big screen in between training sessions, right?

spans.text: The training field is the place with the biggest concentration of agents. Surely some of them would slack off there and watch the big screen in between training sessions, right?

units.rawText: That might be a good idea. Our current efficiency is just too low.
units.displayText: That might be a good idea. Our current efficiency is just too low.

spans.text: That might be a good idea. Our current efficiency is just too low.

units.rawText: We still need to rehearse after handing out flyers. If we can use this to save time...
units.displayText: We still need to rehearse after handing out flyers. If we can use this to save time...

spans.text: We still need to rehearse after handing out flyers. If we can use this to save time...

units.rawText: Excuse me.
units.displayText: Excuse me.

spans.text: Excuse me.

units.rawText: An Agent's cold voice interrupts their conversation. The group turns to see an agent holding a bottle of translucent glue and a stack of 4You posters.
units.displayText: An Agent's cold voice interrupts their conversation. The group turns to see an agent holding a bottle of translucent glue and a stack of 4You posters.

spans.text: An Agent's cold voice interrupts their conversation. The group turns to see an agent holding a bottle of translucent glue and a stack of 4You posters.

units.rawText: He sprays the glue onto a nearby ruined wall and slaps a poster crookedly on it.
units.displayText: He sprays the glue onto a nearby ruined wall and slaps a poster crookedly on it.

spans.text: He sprays the glue onto a nearby ruined wall and slaps a poster crookedly on it.

units.rawText: Posters applied to Area F9.
units.displayText: Posters applied to Area F9.

spans.text: Posters applied to Area F9.

units.rawText: Hey!!!
units.displayText: Hey!!!

spans.text: Hey!!!

units.rawText: Do you always work in such a half-assed way?
units.displayText: Do you always work in such a half-assed way?

spans.text: Do you always work in such a half-assed way?

units.rawText: Your reaction makes no sense. We have applied posters to this region according to operational requirements. Poster coverage in Area F9 is currently at 50%. Coverage objective has been reached.
units.displayText: Your reaction makes no sense. We have applied posters to this region according to operational requirements. Poster coverage in Area F9 is currently at 50%. Coverage objective has been reached.

spans.text: Your reaction makes no sense. We have applied posters to this region according to operational requirements. Poster coverage in Area F9 is currently at 50%. Coverage objective has been reached.

units.rawText: But this poster isn't even stuck on straight... Would you go to a concert if you saw a messed-up poster like this?
units.displayText: But this poster isn't even stuck on straight... Would you go to a concert if you saw a messed-up poster like this?

spans.text: But this poster isn't even stuck on straight... Would you go to a concert if you saw a messed-up poster like this?

units.rawText: If I were ordered to.
units.displayText: If I were ordered to.

spans.text: If I were ordered to.

units.rawText: What would you, personally, think?
units.displayText: What would you, personally, think?

spans.text: What would you, personally, think?

units.rawText: I receive a fixed operand stipend every month. Taking part in activities like these will not increase my efficiency or my operational effectiveness.
units.displayText: I receive a fixed operand stipend every month. Taking part in activities like these will not increase my efficiency or my operational effectiveness.

spans.text: I receive a fixed operand stipend every month. Taking part in activities like these will not increase my efficiency or my operational effectiveness.

units.rawText: The poster-pasting agent ignores 4You. Instead he packs his tools and leaves.
units.displayText: The poster-pasting agent ignores 4You. Instead he packs his tools and leaves.

spans.text: The poster-pasting agent ignores 4You. Instead he packs his tools and leaves.

units.rawText: Urgh... What does this mean for us?
units.displayText: Urgh... What does this mean for us?

spans.text: Urgh... What does this mean for us?

units.rawText: I guess the word "entertainment" doesn't exist in their base layer logic.
units.displayText: I guess the word "entertainment" doesn't exist in their base layer logic.

spans.text: I guess the word "entertainment" doesn't exist in their base layer logic.

units.rawText: If we put on a concert now, we probably won't get much of an audience...
units.displayText: If we put on a concert now, we probably won't get much of an audience...

spans.text: If we put on a concert now, we probably won't get much of an audience...

units.rawText: ...We're running short on time. Let's just go practice first.
units.displayText: ...We're running short on time. Let's just go practice first.

spans.text: ...We're running short on time. Let's just go practice first.

units.rawText: But we have lots of flyers which haven't been given out yet.
units.displayText: But we have lots of flyers which haven't been given out yet.

spans.text: But we have lots of flyers which haven't been given out yet.

units.rawText: We'll just have to wait until our next break, then.
units.displayText: We'll just have to wait until our next break, then.

spans.text: We'll just have to wait until our next break, then.

units.rawText: (Sigh)
units.displayText: Sigh

spans.text: Sigh

units.rawText: Vee walks up to the crooked poster, carefully peels it off the wall, then smooths out the wrinkles before sticking it back on.
units.displayText: Vee walks up to the crooked poster, carefully peels it off the wall, then smooths out the wrinkles before sticking it back on.

spans.text: Vee walks up to the crooked poster, carefully peels it off the wall, then smooths out the wrinkles before sticking it back on.

units.rawText: At the very least... it's got to look like this.
units.displayText: At the very least... it's got to look like this.

spans.text: At the very least... it's got to look like this.

units.rawText: The expansive training field seems even lonelier now that 4You has gone. A gust of wind blows, dislodging the freshly-repasted poster.
units.displayText: The expansive training field seems even lonelier now that 4You has gone. A gust of wind blows, dislodging the freshly-repasted poster.

spans.text: The expansive training field seems even lonelier now that 4You has gone. A gust of wind blows, dislodging the freshly-repasted poster.

units.rawText: The wind carries the poster to the feet of an agent.
units.displayText: The wind carries the poster to the feet of an agent.

spans.text: The wind carries the poster to the feet of an agent.

units.rawText: This is... a 4You poster...
units.displayText: This is... a 4You poster...

spans.text: This is... a 4You poster...

units.rawText: Monitor104 picks it up, and after studying the faces on it, she tucks it away for safekeeping.
units.displayText: Monitor104 picks it up, and after studying the faces on it, she tucks it away for safekeeping.

spans.text: Monitor104 picks it up, and after studying the faces on it, she tucks it away for safekeeping.

units.rawText: Monitor104 patrol duties complete. Beginning scheduled rest period.
units.displayText: Monitor104 patrol duties complete. Beginning scheduled rest period.

spans.text: Monitor104 patrol duties complete. Beginning scheduled rest period.

units.rawText: Now that her day's patrolling is done, Monitor104 walks over to Cyclopes Sector's Treatment Center and heads to a familiar ward.
units.displayText: Now that her day's patrolling is done, Monitor104 walks over to Cyclopes Sector's Treatment Center and heads to a familiar ward.

spans.text: Now that her day's patrolling is done, Monitor104 walks over to Cyclopes Sector's Treatment Center and heads to a familiar ward.

units.rawText: The only source of light in the darkness is the fluorescent green glow of instrument panels, which illuminates the unconscious agent on the sickbed.
units.displayText: The only source of light in the darkness is the fluorescent green glow of instrument panels, which illuminates the unconscious agent on the sickbed.

spans.text: The only source of light in the darkness is the fluorescent green glow of instrument panels, which illuminates the unconscious agent on the sickbed.

units.rawText: Monitor 104 takes out the 4You poster and places it beside a CD labelled 4You.
units.displayText: Monitor 104 takes out the 4You poster and places it beside a CD labelled 4You.

spans.text: Monitor 104 takes out the 4You poster and places it beside a CD labelled 4You.

units.rawText: Complex feelings flow silently in the darkness.
units.displayText: Complex feelings flow silently in the darkness.

spans.text: Complex feelings flow silently in the darkness.

units.rawText: Six days later, at the 4You concert venue in the Cyclopes Sector.
units.displayText: Six days later, at the 4You concert venue in the Cyclopes Sector.

spans.text: Six days later, at the 4You concert venue in the Cyclopes Sector.

units.rawText: The neons glow and the stage lights shine.
units.displayText: The neons glow and the stage lights shine.

spans.text: The neons glow and the stage lights shine.

units.rawText: The difference now is that the occasional cool breeze blows through the stage, while the stark stage lights illuminate the ghastly-white faces of four idols. They have incredulous looks on their faces as they look down at the vacant audience seats below.
units.displayText: The difference now is that the occasional cool breeze blows through the stage, while the stark stage lights illuminate the ghastly-white faces of four idols. They have incredulous looks on their faces as they look down at the vacant audience seats below.

spans.text: The difference now is that the occasional cool breeze blows through the stage, while the stark stage lights illuminate the ghastly-white faces of four idols. They have incredulous looks on their faces as they look down at the vacant audience seats below.

units.rawText: They hadn't exactly expected a warm welcome, but they had never thought things would be this bad.
units.displayText: They hadn't exactly expected a warm welcome, but they had never thought things would be this bad.

spans.text: They hadn't exactly expected a warm welcome, but they had never thought things would be this bad.

units.rawText: No way...
units.displayText: No way...

spans.text: No way...

units.rawText: Not a single person came? Then how is this any different from us practicing by ourselves?
units.displayText: Not a single person came? Then how is this any different from us practicing by ourselves?

spans.text: Not a single person came? Then how is this any different from us practicing by ourselves?

units.rawText: Looks like we were right to be worried, military sectors have nothing in common with entertainment...
units.displayText: Looks like we were right to be worried, military sectors have nothing in common with entertainment...

spans.text: Looks like we were right to be worried, military sectors have nothing in common with entertainment...

units.rawText: This isn't the time to say such things.
units.displayText: This isn't the time to say such things.

spans.text: This isn't the time to say such things.

units.rawText: Clukay grits her teeth and takes a step forward, to her designated spot.
units.displayText: Clukay grits her teeth and takes a step forward, to her designated spot.

spans.text: Clukay grits her teeth and takes a step forward, to her designated spot.

units.rawText: Since we've taken the stage, we ought to perform with all our passion.
units.displayText: Since we've taken the stage, we ought to perform with all our passion.

spans.text: Since we've taken the stage, we ought to perform with all our passion.

units.rawText: The stage is our battlefield. If we don't have an audience... We'll just have to attract one with our show!
units.displayText: The stage is our battlefield. If we don't have an audience... We'll just have to attract one with our show!

spans.text: The stage is our battlefield. If we don't have an audience... We'll just have to attract one with our show!

units.rawText: (Exhales) You've got a point. We ARE professional idols, after all.
units.displayText: (Exhales) You've got a point. We ARE professional idols, after all.

spans.text: (Exhales) You've got a point. We ARE professional idols, after all.

units.rawText: Let's do it, then!
units.displayText: Let's do it, then!

spans.text: Let's do it, then!

units.rawText: With their fighting spirit reignited, the quartet steps onto the stage and begins dancing in time with the music. The rhythmic music circulates through the expansive ruins, seemingly at odds with Cyclopes, yet blending into the surroundings.
units.displayText: With their fighting spirit reignited, the quartet steps onto the stage and begins dancing in time with the music. The rhythmic music circulates through the expansive ruins, seemingly at odds with Cyclopes, yet blending into the surroundings.

spans.text: With their fighting spirit reignited, the quartet steps onto the stage and begins dancing in time with the music. The rhythmic music circulates through the expansive ruins, seemingly at odds with Cyclopes, yet blending into the surroundings.

units.rawText: ...What's this noise? Is it some new kind of weapon? Is it interference?
units.displayText: ...What's this noise? Is it some new kind of weapon? Is it interference?

spans.text: ...What's this noise? Is it some new kind of weapon? Is it interference?

units.rawText: My database cannot match any weapons systems to the current situation. I conjecture that it is an entertainment item known as music.
units.displayText: My database cannot match any weapons systems to the current situation. I conjecture that it is an entertainment item known as music.

spans.text: My database cannot match any weapons systems to the current situation. I conjecture that it is an entertainment item known as music.

units.rawText: (Good, the agents are being drawn in by our song.)
units.displayText: Good, the agents are being drawn in by our song.

spans.text: Good, the agents are being drawn in by our song.

units.rawText: Upon seeing the agents slowly gathering in front of the stage, the members of 4You redouble their efforts.
units.displayText: Upon seeing the agents slowly gathering in front of the stage, the members of 4You redouble their efforts.

spans.text: Upon seeing the agents slowly gathering in front of the stage, the members of 4You redouble their efforts.

units.rawText: This "music" is a strange sound. It's nothing like battle.
units.displayText: This "music" is a strange sound. It's nothing like battle.

spans.text: This "music" is a strange sound. It's nothing like battle.

units.rawText: Their movements are so pretty...
units.displayText: Their movements are so pretty...

spans.text: Their movements are so pretty...

units.rawText: Unable to comprehend. Flagged as irregular behavior.
units.displayText: Unable to comprehend. Flagged as irregular behavior.

spans.text: Unable to comprehend. Flagged as irregular behavior.

units.rawText: Some of the gathered agents seem to be influenced by the song, but most of them can't seem to understand this thing called entertainment. They stare strangely at the members of 4You on the stage.
units.displayText: Some of the gathered agents seem to be influenced by the song, but most of them can't seem to understand this thing called entertainment. They stare strangely at the members of 4You on the stage.

spans.text: Some of the gathered agents seem to be influenced by the song, but most of them can't seem to understand this thing called entertainment. They stare strangely at the members of 4You on the stage.

units.rawText: <color=red>Irregular behavior. Unable to comprehend...</color>
units.displayText: Irregular behavior. Unable to comprehend...

spans.text: Irregular behavior. Unable to comprehend...

units.rawText: Irregular... What?
units.displayText: Irregular... What?

spans.text: Irregular... What?

units.rawText: <color=red>Irregular behavior. No relation to efficiency or operational requirements...</color>
units.displayText: Irregular behavior. No relation to efficiency or operational requirements...

spans.text: Irregular behavior. No relation to efficiency or operational requirements...

units.rawText: <color=red>Irregular behavior.</color>
units.displayText: Irregular behavior.

spans.text: Irregular behavior.

units.rawText: <color=red>Irregular behavior.</color>
units.displayText: Irregular behavior.

spans.text: Irregular behavior.

units.rawText: Many agents begin repeating this statement with vacant eyes like they're chanting a mantra.
units.displayText: Many agents begin repeating this statement with vacant eyes like they're chanting a mantra.

spans.text: Many agents begin repeating this statement with vacant eyes like they're chanting a mantra.

units.rawText: This chilling reaction diminishes the effect of the music and the idols' passion. Slowly, even those agents whose curiosity had begun budding are lost in it until only a single merciless judgment remains—
units.displayText: This chilling reaction diminishes the effect of the music and the idols' passion. Slowly, even those agents whose curiosity had begun budding are lost in it until only a single merciless judgment remains—

spans.text: This chilling reaction diminishes the effect of the music and the idols' passion. Slowly, even those agents whose curiosity had begun budding are lost in it until only a single merciless judgment remains—

units.rawText: <color=red>"Irregular behavior."</color>
units.displayText: "Irregular behavior."

spans.text: "Irregular behavior."

units.rawText: ...How did the concert end up like this?
units.displayText: ...How did the concert end up like this?

spans.text: ...How did the concert end up like this?

units.rawText: Monitor104 watches the agents' reaction from the edges of the audience area and clenches her fists.
units.displayText: Monitor104 watches the agents' reaction from the edges of the audience area and clenches her fists.

spans.text: Monitor104 watches the agents' reaction from the edges of the audience area and clenches her fists.

units.rawText: What are you doing, 104? You're still on patrol!
units.displayText: What are you doing, 104? You're still on patrol!

spans.text: What are you doing, 104? You're still on patrol!

units.rawText: The other agents try to stop Monitor104 from heading off on her own. Monitor104 does not seem bothered by this and pulls away the arms blocking her. She races across the venue, leaps over the security barriers in her way, and sprints toward the stage.
units.displayText: The other agents try to stop Monitor104 from heading off on her own. Monitor104 does not seem bothered by this and pulls away the arms blocking her. She races across the venue, leaps over the security barriers in her way, and sprints toward the stage.

spans.text: The other agents try to stop Monitor104 from heading off on her own. Monitor104 does not seem bothered by this and pulls away the arms blocking her. She races across the venue, leaps over the security barriers in her way, and sprints toward the stage.

units.rawText: Keep going! Keep singing!
units.displayText: Keep going! Keep singing!

spans.text: Keep going! Keep singing!

units.rawText: Don't stop! 4You! Unf...
units.displayText: Don't stop! 4You! Unf...

spans.text: Don't stop! 4You! Unf...

units.rawText: Her distant cries fail to reach the idols on stage...
units.displayText: Her distant cries fail to reach the idols on stage...

spans.text: Her distant cries fail to reach the idols on stage...

units.rawText: Nobody knows who stops dancing first, or who first puts down their mike, but the concert comes to an end in the idols' hearts.
units.displayText: Nobody knows who stops dancing first, or who first puts down their mike, but the concert comes to an end in the idols' hearts.
